sentences.en: Give him an inch and he will take a yard.
sentences.zh: 给他一寸他就想占一码。

sentences.en: I saw my neighbor's dog running around in the yard.
sentences.zh: 我在院子里看见邻居的狗在跑来跑去。

sentences.en: I tied my dog to the tree in the yard.
sentences.zh: 我把狗拴在院子里的树上。

senses.zh: 院子；码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；庭院；帆桁
